summary: Exact zero Schur diagonal admits a product-preserving affine half-Riesz bound, but replacing S_ii=0 by merely |S_ii| small while retaining only the cross-row norm is false. The rank-one family [[epsilon,1],[1,epsilon^-1]] with independent centered unit uniforms has cross-row norm one yet E|X^T S X|^-1/2=infinity. This refutes only the near-zero half-Riesz interface, not QFORM.
